page.overview:
Who is Lo?

Lo is a minor character that made his first and only appearance to date in Mortal Kombat: Deception's Konquest Mode.

He delivered a package with Shujinko to a young woman, who lives in the far southeastern village. When the woman opened it, she realized the package contained purple lotus petals, not those of the black lotus. She gave her earrings to Shujinko to bring them back to Lo as payment.
